# Proposal: Discovery Engagement

## Purpose
We propose a four-week discovery engagement to establish a clear foundation before any implementation work.

## Scope (Four Weeks, Discovery Only)
The engagement produces exactly three artifacts:
1. Current-state process map
2. Prioritized backlog
3. Implementation recommendation

## Commercial Offer

| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Effort | 80 hours |
| Rate | $200 per hour |
| Total Fee | $16,000 |
| Payment | 50% ($8,000) at kickoff; 50% ($8,000) on delivery |

## What Is Excluded
Implementation, integrations, production support, and guaranteed savings are excluded from this engagement. They would require separate agreement.

## Your Responsibilities
The client supplies interview access and source documents to enable the discovery work.

## Start Date
A start date will be agreed only after signature and receipt of a named client contact.

## Acceptance
The sponsor confirms delivery of the three listed artifacts: current-state process map, prioritized backlog, and implementation recommendation.

## How to Proceed
To begin, please:
1. Sign this proposal to confirm acceptance of the scope and fee.
2. Name the client contact who will coordinate access and documents.
3. On receipt of both, we will agree the start date and schedule the kickoff.

We will invoice 50% of the fee at kickoff and the remaining 50% upon your confirmation of the three deliverables.

We look forward to your approval.
